remaining_talent_points.description: Sprint/Evasion cooldown reduction and removal of movement-impairing effects on Sprint; no direct damage effect in the stationary baseline.

assumptions: Maximum weapon skill, as requested by the user.
Instant Poison Rank 1 on both weapons; rank confirmed by user, application to both weapons assumed.
Weapon base damage ranges inherited from supplied context; weapon speeds and DPS corroborated by current Forever search results.
Highest available Sinister Strike and Eviscerate ranks are assumed trained; both are Rank 4 at this level.
Race is unspecified; do not infer or add racial abilities.
